# A doc with fenced examples

## Ph1 The real phase

- REQ-1 The one real requirement.

An example of the convention, in a fence:

```markdown
## Ph9 Not a phase
- REQ-9 Not a requirement
| TP-9 | not a row | REQ-9 |
```

Another fence, with tildes:

~~~
## Ph8 Not a phase either
~~~

> ## Ph7 Quoted
